task.normalInput: One photograph of the plant the user wants to identify
task.primaryGoal: Species identification for common plants encountered in China
task.output: At most five distinct species candidates, or an explicit uncertain/unrecognized result

metrics.normalization: Map predictions to the frozen reviewed species identities and retain the first five distinct identities
metrics.denominator: Every labeled known-target plant test photograph; no model-specific filtering
metrics.unsupportedSpecies: Count as a miss, not a removed sample
metrics.timeoutOrFailure: Count as a miss in end-to-end Top-5; report technical success separately
metrics.unknownAndNonplantInputs: Separate rejection test sets, not known-target species accuracy denominator

firstComparison.training: frozen encoder first; trained on the same authorized target data as B

firstComparison.initialization: official onlyclassifier_then_all checkpoint after complete-file verification
firstComparison.training: replace European classifier; frozen plant-adapted encoder first

firstComparison.role: user-selected local Pl@ntNet solution; start with official pretrained weights
firstComparison.backbone: Read architecture from the selected official checkpoint and load its matching class map
firstComparison.training: Do not train initially. Evaluate pretrained Top-1/Top-5 first; consider fine-tuning only after measured coverage/accuracy gaps and explicit approval
requires: Obtain and verify an actual official pretrained checkpoint and its matching original class-index/species maps
Confirm checkpoint architecture, output dimension, dataset version and applicable license
Do not infer all available checkpoints are legacy solely from the README example
Do not label a checkpoint V2 until its weights and output mapping are verified as V2
If only legacy weights are verified, record their real version and evaluate as a separate pretrained baseline; never attach V2 labels to them
Report target-species coverage and Top-1/Top-5 on the same target test set
firstComparison.readiness: Official SqueezeNet1_0 and ResNet50 checkpoints downloaded, safely loaded and locally tested on identical public test photos; no runtime integration or production switch
firstComparison.initialization: Official pretrained checkpoint first; new training is not a prerequisite for the initial local benchmark

requires: No assumption that public benchmark gains transfer
Same target data and test protocol

datasetRules: Do not use private observation photos without specific permission
Image license and label evidence are separate requirements
Include cultivated/indoor plants, not only wild research-grade observations
Do not train or tune thresholds on the test set
Group observations/photographers and near duplicates before splitting
Document unresolved overlap with foundation-model pretraining
Do not use API/model predictions as their own evaluation ground truth
Do not substitute an easier dataset to force a 1000-class headline
Do not use online recognition APIs for inference, benchmarking or generating training labels

networkPolicy.publicDatasetPreparation: Separate licensed-data preparation; not recognition API use
